Hi team —

Thanks for the great work getting this across the finish line. Quick handoff note and proposed owners so we can stand up the implementation runway this month. High-level context first:

- Account: Peregrine Health (mid-market health network; ~120 clinics).
- Contract: 24-month subscription, Redwood Dedicated, expected go-live (pilot) in 6 weeks (target 2028-05-24).
- Primary contacts: Jared Owens (CTO) and Amy Lin (Head of Integrations).
- Key constraints: data residency in us-east-1, strict firewall rules, and a SOC2 evidence request in procurement.

What I

propose for owners (please react if you'd prefer different assignments):
- Sales owner (post-sign): Karthik Iyer — contract & billing continuity, escalation lane.
- CS lead: Tessa Morgan — overall success owner and kickoff facilitator.
- Implementation lead (technical sprints): Mina Haddad — infra/ops and deployment.
- Exec sponsor / escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (as needed).

Attachments included (stubs below): SOW v1, network requirements spreadsheet, and the mutual action plan with milestones. I pasted the proposed timeline and key acceptance criteria in the MAP doc.

Immediate asks:
1) Tessa — can you confirm owner acceptance and pick a kickoff slot next week (I suggested two in the MAP: 4/18 or 4/20)?
2) Mina — can you review the network_requirements.xlsx and flag anything that needs pre-provisioning from their infra team?
3) Karthik — please ensure billing setup (PO + invoicing contact) is handed to Finance; they already provided a PO number in the last thread.

I'm sharing Jared and Amy on this to make the initial intros explicit; they should be included in the kickoff.

Thanks — short and deliberate handoff so we can avoid a second "re-onboarding".
